I would look to replace Agrippa with Aigis or Helot. You’re kinda triple downing on defensive(Faint, Salva, Agrippa) and replacing one with more utility or offensives would be good. 

Faint likes Burial Ground CoV which can be farmed instead of the “Red Hand”. Her WoDs(Wheels or Weapons) would prefer Death Resistance WoDs; Nothing in particular as any two DR WoDs work. Her Kit is played around Death Resistance stacking.

Salvador’s prefers Cursed Rabbit in this case, which is a WoD you can buy in the shop using a “different” currency, over “The Red Hand”. Otherwise, his SSR WoD is good and would replace the “Mind Barrier” with “Data is Flesh” as that will give you more shielding and healing from his cards. Salva’s kit is around survivability via shielding and healing.

Cantena would like Crimsum Pulse WoD which can be bought from the shop over the “Red Hand”. Since she is DPS, she appreciates Crit Rate and Crit Dmg. WoDs like “Critical Point, Hand of Oblivion, To My Dearest Friend” are loved by her. 

Agrippa’s playstyle is more supportive and defensive. Providing perma Alert(Shield Up), and STR, while shielding. 

Helot is a offensive support Awakener. Her CoV and WoDs can be anything supportive or utility. Her whole thing is Exalting(Ulting) to provide Cantena 80% more Dmg on her “Bloodthirsty Flails”. 

Aigis is a offensive support with a unique stun. Her CoV and WoDs are anything Keyflare related. She provides Keyflare for Posse(Character Ult), Embryo Generation, Perma Vulnerability Debuff(Effectively Increasing your DMG always), and an Exalt that can stun any enemy for one turn ***once***.
